bug_semantics: Snowflake executeQuery builds sqlText from the Query parameter after n8n expression resolution and calls snowflake-sdk execute with empty binds. A workflow that embeds untrusted item/webhook data in that query (historically via getNodeParameter expression evaluation; after the SQL-editor overhaul via getResolvables + evaluateExpression string-replace) interpolates attacker-controlled bytes into the SQL command. Insert/Update already used positional ? binds; executeQuery did not, so quotes/operators in expression values become SQL syntax (CWE-89). Exploitation requires a workflow author to place externally controlled expressions in the raw query.
flaw_origin: The unparameterized executeQuery sink was first written when the Snowflake node was added in PR #1230. Member 98fb09eefb7a98081c7599b4d03e646970da9267 (Ricardo Espinoza, 2020-12-04) created packages/nodes-base/nodes/Snowflake/Snowflake.node.ts with `const query = this.getNodeParameter('query', i) as string; responseData = await execute(connection, query, []);` while the same file already bound insert/update through `?`. Follow-up 311e0bbaeebe34401a12a77620e628303f8d4dd3 only whitespace/icon cleanup. Those members were squash-merged to master as c87382c0867a2628b111d18291c9110d228feab2. beedfb609ccde2ef202e08566580a2e1a6b6eafa later refactored interpolation (noDataExpression + getResolvables) but did not introduce the empty-binds sink.
